body:
One day I decided I was going to eat a gram of oil.  What I did was scrape it out of the cap onto an ice cube in an ice cube tray, put it in the freezer for about 10 minutes, took it out (it was hard like a peice of hard candy) put it in my mouth and swallowed it whole with water like a pill. Somewhere in between 3 to 4 hours later it hit me... hard .... all at once, straight to the peak. The only way I can describe the high is think about the time you've been the most drunk you've ever been in your life and multiply it by a thousand.
I was with my friend doing some business and I needed to drive him home.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
On the way home, we stopped at a railroad crossing and the flashing red lights were so intense I couldnt even look at them. I had my eyes covered so I wouldnt see them. Then I took a peek to check if it was gone.. it wasnt yet .. I told my friend that I had to throw up (the flashing lights got to me I guess). He said 'open your door' I said 'I cant' and I puked all over the inside of my car. I had to get him home, as he had just purchased 2 pounds of weed, so I kept on driving (the car stunk like puke and my clothes were covered in it). Eventually we got to his place and he said I could come up to wash off. I said 'I need a few minutes' and I stayed in the car for 30 mins. I finally got out and threw up a little more and started dry heaving. I couldnt even make it to the apartment door so I decided that I should call somebody to come and get me and take me home, however, they thought that home was not the place for me and rushed me to the hospital. I stayed there over night and was let got eh next morning. They said I overdosed on THC.
All in all I wouldnt recommend ingesting oil to anyone. If you must, do it in a smaller quantity.
